comments.content: I love beoga and no one ever uploaded this tune to the session. its the second tune from a lovely madness from their album, lovely madness

comments.subject: Re: Blue Eyes
comments.content: My only comment is that this would have to be transposed at least in part to play on a standard D Irish Whistle since this goes down to "Low" A and the D whistle only to D.

comments.subject: Re: Blue Eyes
comments.content: You could, there's other ways around that though.     C whistle, octave jump that low A, or, substitute it for another note that still fits the melody.
